title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 292 (Exercise and control of liquidator's powers)

content.overview: Powers of the company liquidator are exercised subject to the control of the Tribunal, and the Tribunal may give directions.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Powers of the company liquidator are exercised subject to the control of the Tribunal, and the Tribunal may give directions.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A creditor or contributory may apply to the Tribunal in respect of the exercise of a power. The section is the supervision gate, not a new power.
